# Clefmark

> Territory sales OS for B2B field teams.

Clefmark is a territory sales platform for B2B teams whose reps work in the real world — driving routes, visiting locations, and building relationships with businesses that have a physical address.

Unlike desk-first tools built around contact lists, Clefmark starts from where: a map, a territory, a place worth pursuing. Reps discover clients on the map, work them through playbooks, and communicate from one inbox — email, SMS, and print mail — with Clefmark assistant grounded in each organization's industry, library, and rules.

## Who it's for

B2B companies with 5–50 field reps selling to local businesses with physical locations: commercial services, distribution, equipment, franchise development, vertical SaaS, and similar.

## Product pillars

- Discover — map and list search with Google, Apple, Yelp; territory filters
- Clients — accounts on your map with contacts, progress, tasks, deals, timeline
- Communicate — unified Inbox for email and SMS
- Automate — scheduled email, SMS, and print mail
- Playbooks — team sequences with call, email, SMS, print, task, wait steps
- Program — team and personal library; activity tracking
- Customize — industry pack, assistant rules, search presets, templates

## Pricing (USD)

- Starter: $29/mo, 1 seat
- Team: $114/mo, up to 5 seats
- Growth: $199/mo, up to 10 seats
- Scale: $399/mo, up to 25 seats
- 14-day trial, no card required
